documents.title: Audited financial statements
documents.text:
Audited financial statements — Kestrel Point Holdings (fictional).
In this document "KPHH" means Kestrel Point Holdings. Kestrel Point Holdings reports interest cover of 2.3x for FY2024. Kestrel Point Holdings reports EBITDA of $83400k for FY2025 on a reported basis. Kestrel Point Holdings reports net debt of $165.53m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Kestrel Point Holdings reports revenue of $722.4m for FY2024 on a reported basis under the original agreement. For Kestrel Point Holdings, the treatment of restructuring add-backs is read as: add-backs limited to costs incurred within 12 months.

documents.title: Lender presentation
documents.text:
Lender presentation — Kestrel Point Holdings (fictional).
Kestrel Point Holdings reports interest cover of 1.8x for FY2025. Kestrel Point Holdings reports EBITDA of $83.4m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Kestrel Point Holdings reports available liquidity of $32.6m for FY2024 on a reported basis. KPHH reports cash margin of 4.5% for FY2024. For Kestrel Point Holdings, the treatment of restructuring add-backs is read as: add-backs include expected future synergies.
